title: Mitochondrial common ancestor ('Mitochondrial Eve')
summary: All living people inherit mitochondrial DNA through their mothers from one woman in Africa. Estimates of her age run from about 234,000 to 99,000 years ago; as of 2013 they clustered around 155,000.
why: She was one of many women alive then; only her maternal line happens to survive in everyone.

notes.problem: 'One 2013 estimate is about 160,000' not in source; source: 'As of 2013, estimates ... ranged at around 155,000 years ago' (year = 1950-155000).
